reason: The local evidence supports issue #71: both attempts are complete and checksum-valid, the matched baseline restores and migrates exactly, and the declared one-line candidate defect is accountably rejected as stale state.

evidence_checks.evidence: sha256sum -c verified all 70 baseline and 73 candidate entries. File-set comparison found no omitted attempt artifact except checksums.sha256 itself.

Both records have lifecycle_state=completed, execution.status=completed, accounting_eligible=true, no phase errors, four completed Journey turns, and all expected phases. Baseline exited 0; candidate exited 1 for its accountable L2 rejection.

Read-only provenance replay validated run-spec snapshots, host commit f89635eef819445db15a698f15e3c7ef9277500c, device/tool identities, role receipts, deployment, and installed hashes. Baseline APK is 1a8cc170e310417f37447dd68bea1de853b1f8ed2d11d962a3662ba5cef85c0c; candidate is 535f04161fef62ac7bb89ebb873279224463b38db971691d5baa7b6a89e33fac. Each archived APK, sidecar, provenance entry, and installed-APK entry agrees. APK manifests identify dev.aiverify.lifecyclefixture/MainActivity.

evidence_checks.check: matched Journey actions, events, and assertions
evidence_checks.evidence: Removing only candidate.yaml's diff field makes its bytes hash-identical to baseline.yaml. The four requested-action hashes, four actual prompt hashes, three event/argument hashes, trigger steps, package, activity, APK glob, and four assertions match across attempts.

The captured and applied host patches are byte-identical and contain one addition plus one deletion in StateStore.java only, changing schemaVersion != LEGACY_SCHEMA to ==. APK bytecode independently confirms the baseline if-eq guard becomes candidate if-ne, producing the declared stale-migration guard defect.

Both rotation events passed with requested rotation=1, accelerometer_rotation=0, and observed user_rotation=1; screenshots change from portrait to landscape. Process IDs are disjoint: baseline 25596 to 25913 and candidate 24543 to 24856.

Both events selected com.android.localtransport/.LocalTransport, recorded package-specific backup Success, restore token 1, restoreFinished: 0, restore success, and post-restore PIDs 26243 and 25180. At the captured commit, a passed event is emitted only after pm clear returns Success and the original GMS transport/disabled state is restored.

All fourteen capture manifests passed and retain layouts, screenshots, logcats, and command records. Baseline shows sentinel/v1/41/PENDING initially, after rotation, and after process death, then sentinel/v2/42/MIGRATED after restore. Candidate preserves sentinel but remains v1/41/PENDING after restore. Visual screenshot inspection agrees with the layouts; retained logcats contain no target-package fatal-crash marker.

Baseline reports L1 inconclusive and L2 pass with all four assertions satisfied. Candidate reports L1 inconclusive and L2 fail, with exact mismatches 2→1, 42→41, and MIGRATED_V1_TO_V2→PENDING_V1_TO_V2.
Stored outputs and independent read-only replay agree: baseline is accountable correct_restoration/locally_supported; candidate is accountable stale_state/locally_rejected.

Direct read-only oracle exercises produced correct_restoration, crash, state_loss, silent_reset, and stale_state as specified. Invalid layout, unchanged process identity, and missing restore token each produced non_accountable.

limitations: This conclusion is limited to the recorded local API-35 emulator, APKs, toolchain, and attempts; no fresh device execution was performed during this read-only audit.
The final attempt directories were untracked at the audited HEAD, so this is local-only evidence until those artifacts and this conclusion are committed.
No detection-rate, Goldset, compatibility-matrix, cloud-provider, or upstream-acceptance claim is made.
